reason: The patch adds a `t.Skip` for `dbType == "postgres"` with a `TODO - fix this test for postgres` at pkg/server/module_server_test.go:35-38, and this is the only test that targets `modules.StorageServer` and checks `/metrics` (line 45 is the sole test reference), so with sqlite already skipped only mysql still runs it. The same patch adds eager `s.Init(ctx)` in `NewResourceServer` (pkg/storage/unified/resource/server.go:258-262); that this is what breaks postgres in Drone is plausible but not provable from source alone.
